title: Build Verification For Camera-As-View-Action And Command-History Effort
description: Build/verify step for the just-completed repo-wide effort: (1) universal session command-history mechanism in semio-framework-plugin + semio-framework-core, (2) camera/viewport actions converted from VCS Operations to session-only View actions across every app plugin (puzzle 2d/3d/5d, raster, trinity, architect, cad, fem 2d/3d, shooting, writer, sequence, mathematical, lowpoly, note, draw, layout), (3) shell-chrome command notes (noteShellCommand) wired through React + native wgpu renderers, (4) React renderer setCamera dispatch nesting fix. Run cargo check --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace --lib across the touched crate set; report clean/errors and pass/fail counts, separating genuinely-new regressions from confirmed pre-existing issues (icon-catalog missing entries, architect_spine wellness field mismatch, architect-spine missing from cargo workspace, etc.) via git diff/log evidence. Then find and run the plugin WASM build/registry mechanism to rebuild the puzzle plugin's WASM (aggregator app puzzle3d-play, brand entwerfen-mit-bestand) so the dev shell picks up all these changes; rebuild other touched plugin WASM modules if the same build step covers them. Also check whether the previously-blocking missing framework-surface-paint-rs WASM artifact is now present and, if so, run the React renderer (@semio-tech/framework-renderer-react) vitest suite.
